name: ViT deepfake-vs-real face classifier (dima806)
limitations: Weights are not committed; transformers downloads the ~330 MB ViT snapshot from the hub_model id on first use (or set hub_model to a local snapshot directory for offline runs).
Trained on real-vs-synthetic face imagery — detects face-domain manipulation/generation, not full-scene synthetic content; non-face images are gated out by requires_face.

Community checkpoint: validated locally on a real portrait (scored real) and a self-blended manipulation (scored fake); broad per-generator recall is still unmeasured — see experiments/FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md.
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label; absence of a face makes this member inapplicable rather than a 'real' verdict.
notes: Runtime 'hf-image-classifier' uses AutoImageProcessor + AutoModelForImageClassification; 'score_label' resolves the softmax index from the model's id2label so label order cannot silently flip the score.
Local check (2026-09): lenna-face.png -> Real 0.992, lenna-face-sbi.png -> Fake 0.783, lenna.png -> Real 0.996.
Replaces the rejected efficientnet-b0-ffpp-c23 community checkpoint, which scored a real face at 96% fake.
